questions.stem: How does Data Identification relate to Data Anonymisation?
options: Data Identification is performed after Data Anonymisation
Data Identification is the prerequisite for Data Anonymisation, since data must be identified before it can be anonymised
Data Identification replaces the need for Data Anonymisation
Data Anonymisation is a step within Data Identification
questions.explanation: Data Identification is the opposite of, and the prerequisite for, Data Anonymisation: one must first identify data before anonymising it.

questions.stem: What is Data Identification concerned with?
options: The set of details which assist in identifying an entity or individual
Assigning primary keys to every table
Choosing which server hosts a database
questions.explanation: Data Identification is about those details, direct or indirect, which help identify an entity or individual.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an indirect identifying detail?
options: A unique identification number that links to other datasets to identify an individual
questions.explanation: Direct details include name, contact number, address and credit card number; an indirect detail is a unique identification number that connects with other datasets.

questions.stem: In a data migration project, what is the correct order of activities involving Data Identification?
options: Data migration, then data discovery, then data identification
Data discovery, then data identification, then data migration
Data identification, then data migration, then data discovery
Data migration only; identification is not required
Data identification, then data discovery, then data migration
questions.explanation: The process is to first conduct data discovery, then data identification, and only then can data migration take place.

questions.stem: On which kind of dataset is it recommended practice to perform Data Identification?
questions.explanation: Data Identification can be done in structured, semi-structured and unstructured datasets, but the recommended practice is to do it in structured datasets.

questions.stem: Which artefacts are named as a good source for Data Identification?
questions.explanation: Data dictionaries and data glossaries are a good source for data identification.

questions.stem: Which discipline being in place makes Data Anonymisation easy, according to the benefits of Data Identification?
questions.explanation: Data Anonymisation becomes easy when Metadata Management is in place.

questions.stem: How does Data Lineage help once elements have been identified?
options: It tracks where an identified element has come from and where it will flow to
It converts identified elements into reference data
It assigns identified elements to a data owner
questions.explanation: Data Lineage makes life easy by tracking where an identified element has come from or where it will flow to.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a benefit of Data Identification?
options: Better Data Cleansing and Data Wrangling
Data Quality implementation becomes highly achievable
Support for defining Golden Records in Master Data Management
questions.explanation: Data Identification assists cleansing, wrangling, data quality, golden records and reference data; reduced storage cost is not among its benefits.

questions.stem: In Master Data Management, where does Data Identification play a vital role?
questions.explanation: While defining Golden Records during Master Data Management, or defining Reference data, Data Identification plays a vital role.
